hello.note: Polite, for anyone. Friends say Здрасти (ZDRAS-ti) or Здравей

how-are-you.note: Polite and the same for anyone

im-well.note: The same for a man or a woman

good-night.note: Only when parting at night. Good evening is Добър вечер (DO-buhr VE-cher)

please.note: Also means you're welcome and pardon?

yes.note: Careful: Bulgarians traditionally shake the head for yes and nod for no. Say the word, and don't trust the gesture

excuse-me.note: Sorry, and excuse me to get attention or get past

my-name.note: Literally "I call myself". The audio uses Peter as the example name

your-name.note: Polite and the same for anyone

dont-understand.note: The same for a man or a woman

speak-english.note: Many young Bulgarians do; Russian is understood by older people

thousand.note: Bulgaria adopted the euro in 2026; you may still hear prices in leva (LE-va)

would-like.note: Literally "is it possible...?", the polite way to order, the same for a man or a woman. The audio uses едно кафе (ed-NO ka-FE), a coffee

i-want.note: More direct. The audio uses това (to-VA), this one

discount.note: Fine at markets, not in shops

card.note: Cards work in cities; villages and markets may want cash

taxi.text: Може ли да ми повикате такси?
taxi.say: MO-zhe lee da mee po-VEE-ka-te tak-SEE
taxi.note: Use a yellow taxi from a known company, or an app, and check the price per km on the window

bus.note: Buses are often quicker than trains between towns

train-station.note: Sofia's main station is Централна гара (tsen-TRAL-na GA-ra)

which-train.note: The audio uses Пловдив (PLOV-deev), Plovdiv, as the example

two-tickets.note: The audio uses Plovdiv as the example

trip-length.note: The audio uses Plovdiv as the example
trip-length.spoken: Колко време се пътува до Пловдив?

allergic.note: Literally "I have an allergy to", the same for a man or a woman. Add the food: ядки (YAD-kee) nuts, фъстъци (fuh-STUH-tsee) peanuts, яйца (yay-TSA) eggs. The audio uses nuts

love-dish.note: Literally "I like this dish very much"

what-called.note: Point at the dish or item

recommend.note: Start with a shopska salad and a glass of rakia

tea.note: Often a herbal tea, such as mountain tea, мурсалски чай

milk.note: Bulgarian yoghurt, кисело мляко (KEE-se-lo MLYA-ko), sour milk, is famous

hot.note: Hot, of food, drinks and weather

cheers.note: Look each person in the eye

help.note: Shout it. For any emergency, call 112

need-doctor.note: Literally "a doctor is needed by me", the same for a man or a woman. For an ambulance, call 112
